Description: Enables the developer debug GUI overlay with verbose stats and panels\n\nConfirmed in VRChat docs and VRCX-0 source
Enables SDK debug log level filtering — required for SDK/Udon log visibility\n\nConfirmed in VRChat docs and VRCX-0 localization
Enables full verbose debug logging for UdonSharp/Udon programs\n\nConfirmed in VRChat docs and VRCX-0 localization
Fixes AVPro video player compatibility under Wine/Proton on Linux\n\nLinux/Proton-specific; use this on Steam Deck and Linux
Enables hardware-accelerated video decoding for video players (GPU decode)\n\nImproves performance on supported GPU; common on Linux
Configures OSC ports: inPort:senderIP:outPort format\n\ne.g. --osc=9000:127.0.0.1:9001. Required for VRCOSC and other OSC tools
Sets the target frame rate cap for VRChat rendering\n\nUnity engine cap; higher = more CPU/GPU load
Sets CPU thread affinity hex bitmask for the VRChat process — for AMD CPU optimization\n\nFFFF=16 threads; wrong value causes crashes. Advanced/AMD only
Sets the OS process priority level for VRChat\n\n-2=Idle,-1=Below Normal,0=Normal,1=Above Normal,2=High
Bypasses Steam client requirement when launching via launch.exe directly\n\nOnly works with the launcher.exe direct launch method
Launches with a separate isolated settings profile directory\n\nCreates a subfolder in AppData for isolated settings
Loads a specific world by ID on startup (e.g. wrld_...)\n\nUseful for testing — skips startup world loading
Joins or creates a specific instance from launch\n\ne.g. wrld_abc:12345~region(us)
Forces VRChat to launch in Desktop (non-VR) mode\n\nOverrides HMD auto-detection
Sets window/render width in pixels (Unity standard arg)\n\nStandard Unity standalone player argument
Sets window/render height in pixels (Unity standard arg)\n\nStandard Unity standalone player argument
Sets fullscreen mode — 0=windowed 1=fullscreen (Unity standard arg)\n\nStandard Unity standalone player argument
Selects which monitor to launch on (1-based index) (Unity standard arg)\n\nStandard Unity standalone player argument
Sets the initial Unity quality preset to use (Unity standard arg)\n\nStandard Unity standalone player argument
Redirects Unity output log to specified file path (Unity standard arg)\n\nDefault: %APPDATA%/LocalLow/VRChat/VRChat/output_log.txt
